RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence is professionally risky and legally unsubstantiated. For executive positions like planning director, hiring committees often prioritize public engagement skills, political acumen, and organizational fit over specific degrees or years of service. A candidate with strong public consultation expertise may have better aligned with the municipality’s current strategic priorities or simply interviewed better. 

Demographics alone do not indicate discrimination. Suggesting bias without evidence will damage your reputation across the municipal sector. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your feedback request, framing it constructively around your professional development and what competencies you can strengthen for future director-level opportunities.
